items.text: Rams get back Puka Nacua as Eagles prepare to be without DeVonta Smith; little optimism Smith plays Sunday vs Rams (hamstring).
items.why: Sidelined all week with hamstring; sources expect he won’t go.
items.implication: Eagles WR targets shift; Nacua returns for favorable matchup.
items.opportunity: Primary targets to Wicks/others; Nacua snap/route share resumes.

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring injury; coach confirmation via Rapoport.
items.implication: Misses minimum 4 games; Kamara/Miller/Neal role expansion.
items.opportunity: Lead back and receiving work opens in NO backfield.

items.text: Jaylen Warren on LOVE list as top 10 play this week despite short week after big usage; believes in him for TNF.
items.why: Strong prior usage; short-week RB risk acknowledged but still top-10.
items.implication: Start with confidence in TNF vs CLE.
items.opportunity: High snap/route share confirmed in recent data.

items.text: Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers upgraded to full participants Thursday.
items.implication: Clear path for both to play at full capacity.

items.text: Breece Hall week-to-week with quad; DNP Thursday, unlikely Week 4.
items.why: Quad injury from Week 3; good MRI news but no practice.
items.implication: Allen handles workhorse; Hall questionable earliest Week 5.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed out for the season (neck surgery/IR).
items.why: Neck injury requiring surgery; LaFleur confirmation.
items.implication: Permanent target vacuum in GB WR room.
items.opportunity: Increased roles for Watson and others.

items.text: De'Von Achane suffered torn ACL in Week 3, season-ending.
Rams HC Sean McVay expects WR Puka Nacua (groin) to play Sunday vs Eagles.
items.implication: Full WR1 usage returns opposite potential Smith absence.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert (knee) DNP Thursday along with Smith.
items.implication: TE targets may scatter if out.

items.text: Seahawks designated RB Zach Charbonnet to return to practice.
items.implication: Potential depth chart shift vs Walker soon.

items.text: Drake Maye downplays shoulder issue; full practice noted earlier.
